            idx += 1
            s = set(map(int, input[idx:idx + k]))
            idx += k
            sets.append(s)
        found = False
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                if len(sets[i] & sets[j]) >= 2:
                    results.append(f"{i + 1} {j + 1}")
                    found = True
                    break
            if found:
                break
        if not found:
            results.append("-1")
